planned_by: Owner request: page must show current performance level and improvement, measured
goal:
PERFORMANCE PAGE — show how well EvoForge performs now and how much it improved, using MEASURED numbers only.
Principle: a number appears only when a server measurement backs it. Missing measurement = explicit 'not measured' with the reason, never a default, never a placeholder.

1. Baseline: X_SINGLE = one Builder attempt per sealed v0 task (existing run_baseline). Stored as a measurement record:
   {measurement_id, kind:'X_SINGLE', suite_version, model, harness_version, n, passed, pass_rate, wilson95:[lo,hi],
    cost_cents, created_at, per_family:{family:{n,passed}}, evidence_id}.
2. Pipeline: POST /v1/eval/pipeline {suite_version:'v0', model} runs the same 12 tasks with the adaptive pipeline:
   up to 3 Builder attempts per task; after a failed attempt the Builder receives ONLY the names of failing tests and their
   assertion error lines (never held-out code, never reference fixes); a task passes if any attempt's patch passes its held-out
   suite. Stored as kind:'PIPELINE' with the same fields plus attempts_total and cost_cents (sum of ALL settled attempts).
   Each attempt goes through reserve -> settle with the existing ProviderNotAccepted/UNKNOWN mapping.
   COST IS USAGE-DERIVED, NOT A CONSTANT: each attempt's settled amount is computed from the provider's returned usage
   (prompt tokens x input price + completion and reasoning tokens x output price + cached read tokens x cache price,
   rounded up to integer cents). Prices come from server config EVO_PRICE_INPUT_PER_MTOK / EVO_PRICE_OUTPUT_PER_MTOK /
   EVO_PRICE_CACHE_READ_PER_MTOK, defaulting to 1.25 / 4.25 / 0.15 USD per million tokens (the rates fitted from the
   OpenCode session store). The reservation is made at the conservative per-attempt maximum, then settled to the
   usage-derived value. If usage is missing from the response, the attempt is settled at the maximum and marked
   usage_missing:true in the record. cost_cents is the sum of settled attempts; never a fixed constant.
3. Budget guardrail: env EVO_EVAL_MAX_CENTS (default 500). Before starting any eval, the server reserves the worst case
   (tasks x attempts x per-attempt budget) and refuses with 402 if it would exceed the cap or the ledger; the page shows the refusal.
4. GET /v1/performance -> {
     baseline: {status:'measured'|'not_measured', reason, ...latest X_SINGLE record or null},
     pipeline: {status, reason, ...latest PIPELINE record or null},
     comparison: {status:'measured'|'not_measured', reason, delta_pp, verdict:'improved'|'no_clear_difference'|'worse'|null}
       verdict uses the two Wilson intervals: 'improved' only if pipeline lo > baseline hi; 'worse' only if pipeline hi < baseline lo; else 'no_clear_difference'.
       delta_pp = 100 * (pipeline.pass_rate - baseline.pass_rate), null unless both measured. Same suite_version and model required.
     cost_per_solved_cents: {baseline, pipeline} = cost_cents / passed, null if not measured or passed == 0,
     history: [all measurement summaries, oldest first, no code],
     production: {runs, gate_pass, gate_fail, gate_inconclusive, heldout_pass_rate_pct, sample_note} computed from server evidence
       of /v1/runs (live customer-free owner runs), labelled as operational samples, with n shown.
   }
   Measurements persist for the process; the response states storage:'memory' until the PostgreSQL store lands (honest).
5. HTTP: no held-out code, reference fix, task file contents or prompts ever in any response (sha256/len only where code appears).
6. Web: apps/web/app/performance/page.tsx (new). Show: headline cards (X_SINGLE rate with 95% interval, PIPELINE rate with
   interval, verdict in plain Korean, delta in percentage points), cost per solved task for both, per-family table, history
   bar list, production sample card, a 'how measured' panel (suite, n, model, attempts, Wilson interval, budget cap). Each
   'not_measured' card shows the reason and no number. Buttons: 'X_SINGLE 측정 실행' and 'Pipeline 측정 실행' call the
   proxy; disabled while running; show the 402 refusal text when the cap blocks. Use integer cents formatting only.
   Mobile width (375px) must work without horizontal scroll.
7. Proxy allowlist (apps/web/lib/proxyPolicy.ts + proxyPolicy.cases.json): exactly /v1/performance, /v1/eval/suites,
   /v1/eval/baseline, /v1/eval/pipeline. No other eval paths.
8. Mission Control (apps/web/app/page.tsx): add one headline card linking to /performance showing the latest measured
   comparison or 'not measured yet'.
Out of scope: changing run semantics, gate verdict rules, contracts, ledger math, PostgreSQL code (Codex).
